title: Texas blues in individuals: guitarists, boogie woogie, gospel singers
summary: They agree Texas blues lived with solo guitarists, pianists and singers, not bands, and was distinct from the Delta and New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
